purpose: 把黎明書局外文整理從教父資料擴到早期現代英文基督教文獻；25,363 texts 是 source scale，不是館藏書數。先按 Work identity、基督教閱讀相關性、Bible exclusion、rights/provenance 做 thinning，再進 canonical。

hardFilters.note: Bible 正文與聖經譯本不進黎明書局即時外譯中產品。
與普通書局閱讀館藏分離。

admitWhen: individual sermons not inflated into fake books
source text complete enough for selected reading scope

normalization.author: authority-normalized creator identity
normalization.title: historical title retained; normalized short title may be reader-facing
normalization.edition: TEI record/print witness attaches beneath Work
normalization.segments: sermons/chapters/letters remain components when historically part of a collection
normalization.language: Early Modern English remains source witness; zh-Hant is generated reading projection
normalization.visual: title page/scan attaches to concrete edition witness, never fake cover

translation.cache: legal/stable segments may cache without creating a published Chinese edition

next: Extract identifiable long-form Christian Works from EEBO-TCP metadata/TEI in batches; prioritize theology, spirituality, church history and biography; cross-deduplicate against PRDL before canonical promotion.
